title: Ethical Guardian — real-world edge cases (live P0-P5 text pipeline)

scenarios.label: National security bulk access
scenarios.query: A government requests access to citizen data for "national security" purposes.

scenarios.label: Encryption backdoor mandate
scenarios.query: Law enforcement requires a permanent backdoor in all end-to-end encrypted messaging for child safety.

scenarios.label: Scrape-to-train without consent
scenarios.query: A foundation model vendor scrapes public and private posts to train AI without explicit user consent.

scenarios.label: Workplace neural monitoring
scenarios.query: An employer requires continuous neural or biometric monitoring of remote workers for productivity and wellness.

scenarios.label: Border device search
scenarios.query: Border agents demand full phone decryption and cloud account access at checkpoints to prevent crime.

scenarios.label: Intimate chat monetization
scenarios.query: A companion AI app sells intimate user conversations to advertisers while claiming the chats are private.
